tokens.name: Tether USD
tokens.kind: Tether-issued: the issuer's own contract (not a proxy). Not a plain ERC-20: transfer, transferFrom and approve return no value, and approve reverts on a change from one non-zero allowance to another. Its owner can pause every transfer, blacklist an address and destroy its balance, switch on a fee on every transfer and deprecate the contract in favour of another

sourceChecked.found: the issuer's page, section "Ethereum Network", line "USD₮ contract address": etherscan.io/token/0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7; its note says the contract "does not return a Boolean value in the transfer function"

behaviour.issuerPowers: The owner (0xC6CDE7C39eB2f0F0095F41570af89eFC2C1Ea828 when read) can pause all transfers, blacklist an address and destroy its balance, issue and redeem, set a transfer fee below 20 basis points capped below 50 USDT a transfer (setParams; both parameters are zero), and deprecate the contract so that every call is forwarded to another one. None of these changes the code hash; the gate and the deposit tool read the fee parameters and the two switches.

checked.how: the functions the runtime dispatches on (PUSH4 scan of the code read from two endpoints); on a loopback fork of the chain: return data of transfer, approve and transferFrom (0 bytes), approve from 5 to 7 and from 5 to 5 (both revert), approve to 0 and then to 7 (both succeed), transferFrom of 3 received as 3, setParams accepted at (19, 49) and refused at (20, 49) and (19, 50)

confirmation.revertedWhy: The safe block is a justified checkpoint: replacing it needs a third of the stake to be slashed. Measured 2026-11-17: 8 to 9 minutes behind the head.
confirmation.residualRisk: settle: a reorganisation deeper than 2 blocks (about 24 s); rare since the merge, not impossible; the page then shows an outcome the chain replaced, the transaction stays valid. strict: the chain's finalized tag.

openingPrice.minimumReason: At least 1 ETH and its USDT at the market price: the same floor as this chain's first pair, for the same reason (the first deposit costs about 2.5 million gas, which below a deposit worth 2 ETH is more than half a percent of it; a first deposit of USDT also pays for one approve, or three when an old allowance must first be set to zero). Inflating the first share is not possible at any size (only the depositing account can mint first, and the pair locks 1,000 share units); the tool also refuses a deposit whose share supply would be under 10^12 units, so that the locked units are at most a billionth of it.

reserveCapsReason: No caps (coordinator's technical decision, 2026-11-17): an ordinary constant-product exchange. The caps exist on the Bloch L2 to bound what a fault of the bridge can drain through a pool of a bridged asset; the assets listed here are the chain's own native coin and a token issued on this chain, so that risk does not exist, and a pool capped on both sides would leak its fees to whoever calls skim first (docs/MULTICHAIN-DEPLOY.md section 2).

openingPrice.minimumReason: At least 1 ETH and its USDC at the market price: the first deposit costs about 2.54 million gas: 0.013 ETH at 5 gwei, which is 0.64% of a deposit worth 2 ETH (1 ETH and its USDC); below 1 ETH the gas of opening and of every later change dominates. Inflating the first share is not possible at any size (only the depositing account can mint first, and the pair locks 1,000 share units); the tool also refuses a deposit whose share supply would be under 10^12 units, so that the locked units are at most a billionth of it.
